name: JRB Remote Site API for OpenClaw
author: jrbconsulting

sections.description: JRB Remote Site API for OpenClaw provides a secure bridge between your WordPress environment and the OpenClaw agent ecosystem. It extends the WordPress REST API to support remote site management, plugin updates, and integration with FluentCRM, FluentSupport, and other popular plugins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jrb-remote-site-api-openclaw folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your API token in the ‘JRB Remote API’ settings page.
